ourQualities.title: QUALITY FOOD
ourQualities.description: We use only the finest, freshly sourced ingredients to prepare every dish. Our commitment to quality ensures a rich, wholesome dining experience every single time.

ourQualities.title: SUPER TASTE
ourQualities.description: Our expert chefs blend traditional recipes with modern techniques, creating bold and unforgettable flavors that keep our guests coming back for more.

ourQualities.title: FAST DELIVERY
ourQualities.description: Enjoy your favorite meals delivered hot and fresh to your doorstep. Our efficient delivery system ensures your food arrives quickly without compromising on taste.

dishes.title: PANEER TIKKA MASALA
dishes.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich tomato and onion gravy, infused with aromatic Indian spices.

dishes.title: SHAHI PANEER
dishes.description: A rich and delicious royal paneer dish cooked in a creamy cashew and tomato gravy.

dishes.title: ALOO PARATHA
dishes.description: Warm, buttery flatbread stuffed with a spiced potato mixture, served fresh from the griddle.

dishes.title: STUFFED STRAWBERRY
dishes.description: Fresh strawberries stuffed with cream cheese and drizzled with chocolate ganache.

dishes.title: VEGGIE BURGER MEAL
dishes.description: Crispy vegetable patty with fresh lettuce, melted cheese, and a tangy signature sauce in a toasted bun.

dishes.title: CREAMY MUSHROOM SOUP
dishes.description: A rich, creamy broth loaded with fresh earthy mushrooms and aromatic herbs.

dishes.title: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI
dishes.description: Classic Italian spaghetti with a rich tomato basil sauce, topped with parmesan.

dishes.title: GRILLED PANEER SKEWERS
dishes.description: Freshly grilled paneer chunks marinated in fiery spices, served with mint chutney and veggies.
